crossRefs.note: In my ears, Yahweh of Armies says: “Surely many houses will be desolate, even great and beautiful, unoccupied.
Now Yahweh had revealed to Samuel a day before Saul came, saying,
Surely the Lord Yahweh will do nothing, unless he reveals his secret to his servants the prophets.
The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it…
Therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli that the iniquity of Eli’s house shall not be removed with sacrifice or…
“ ‘ “In your filthiness is lewdness. Because I have cleansed you and you weren’t cleansed, you won’t be cleansed from…
Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go…
For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,
but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.
He who acts unjustly, let him act unjustly still. He who is filthy, let him be filthy still. He who is righteous, let…
“Behold, I come quickly. My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.

translations.web: Yahweh of Armies revealed himself in my ears, “Surely this iniquity will not be forgiven you until you die,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.
translations.bsb: The LORD of Hosts has revealed in my hearing: “Until your dying day, this sin of yours will never be atoned for,” says the Lord GOD of Hosts.
translations.kjv: And it was revealed in mine ears by the LORD of hosts, Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die, saith the Lord GOD of hosts.
translations.asv: And Jehovah of hosts revealed himself in mine ears, Surely this iniquity shall not be forgiven you till ye die, saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts.
